requirements.title: A conditional expression is a primary selecting a chosen subexpression
requirements.definition: A conditional expression is classified as a primary and selects a chosen subexpression. The detailed conditional evaluation rules, including which guards or expressions are evaluated, are dependencies rather than local fixture coverage.
requirements.oracle:
Future controls use distinct literal arm values and separately satisfy C1004. They must not claim short-circuit evaluation coverage beyond the rules later catalogued for 10.1.4.

Batch291 expressions runtime/diagnostic fixtures: one run/effect/f2023 program uses conditional expressions as primaries and side-effecting branch functions to show that true, false, and chained selections evaluate exactly the chosen branch in the observed single-image cases.

requirements.title: A conditional expression has parenthesized guarded arms and a final fallback expression
requirements.definition: The conditional-expr syntax is an opening parenthesis, a scalar-logical-expr guard, question mark, an expr, zero or more ': scalar-logical-expr ? expr' repetitions, a colon, a final expr, and a closing parenthesis.
requirements.oracle:
Syntax negatives must keep all expressions declared and C1004-compatible so the malformed conditional punctuation or shape is the only cited defect.

Batch291 expressions runtime/diagnostic fixtures: three positive controls cover the two-arm form, chained guarded form, and scalar logical guard, while two compile diagnostic fixtures omit only the final colon or only the question mark. Repairs are the corresponding positive forms.

requirements.title: All conditional-expression result arms have the same declared type, kind parameters, and rank
requirements.definition: Each expr result arm of a conditional-expr shall have the same declared type, the same kind type parameters, and the same rank. The constraint applies to all selectable result expressions, not to the scalar logical guards.
requirements.oracle:
Negative plans must use syntactically valid conditionals with scalar logical guards so the reported defect is the arm characteristic mismatch, not malformed R1002 syntax or invalid logical expressions.

Batch291 expressions runtime/diagnostic fixtures: two positive-control programs check scalar INTEGER arms of the same type, kind, and rank plus a chained same-characteristics form. Three diagnostics isolate declared-type, kind-parameter, and rank mismatches; the rank negative changes only the false arm from scalar 2 to rank-one [2], and the [2] -> 2 repair runs on both compilers.
